adjuvant radio‐ therapy (RT) after breast‐conservative surgery (BCS) is associated with a significant survival benefit among elderly women with ER‐negative, node‐negative breast cancer.

adjuvant radio‐therapy is associated with improved overall survival (OS) among women aged 70 years and older with early‐stage, hormone receptor‐negative breast cancers, and that this association is not explained by differences in comorbidity or treatment patterns.

the effect of adjuvant radiation therapy on the survival of elderly women with T2N0 breast cancer, who are ER‐negative, and have undergone breast‐conserving surgery.
the effect of radiotherapy on the overall survival (OS) of elderly women with T2N0 ER‐negative breast cancer who underwent breast‐conserving surgery (BCS).

the addition of adjuvant RT to BCT is not beneficial in elderly women with ER‐negative breast cancer and that the omission of RT in this setting is safe.

there was insufficient evidence for or against the use of adjuvant RT in elderly women with T2N0 ER‐negative breast cancer, and that adjuvant RT should be used with caution in women aged ≥70 years with T2N1 or T3N0 ER‐positive breast cancer, and in women aged < 70 years with ER‐negative or ER‐positive breast cancers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the benefit of adjuvant RT among elderly women with ER‐negative breast cancer was not clear.
the addition of RT to BCT is associated with a small but significant reduction in the risk of local recurrence among older women with T1–2 N0 ER‐negative breast cancer.
we were able to show that RT after BCS in ER‐negative patients is associated with improved survival in elderly patients, and that this effect appears to be independent of age.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adjuvant RT is associated with improved overall survival (OS) in women aged ≥70 years with early‐stage, ER‐negative breast cancer.
adjuvant radio‐therapy (RT) after breast‐conservating surgery (BCS) is not associated with a reduction in mortality in women ≥ 70 years with ER‐negative breast cancer (T1‐T2, N0).
the benefits of RT in older women are similar to those seen in younger women.
